leaves.name: newformRepConductor
leaves.doc: R17, existence form (r17-bypass): for a weight-2 newform f of level N and every l, iota_C, iota_L there is a semisimple continuous rho : G_Q -> GL_2(Qbar_l) attached to f (Tate normalization, trace form) whose Serre-Tate conductor exponent at every prime p != l is v_p(N). Carayol 1986 Theoreme (A) with Casselman's a(pi_p) = v_p(N), for the representation rho_{f,lambda} itself; the transport to every semisimple attached rho (Brauer-Nesbitt, Chebotarev, invariance of condExp) is proved in Lean. Replaces r17.
leaves.flag: pending reading: the conductor packaging (rho_{f,lambda} has prime-to-l conductor N) is believed printed in Darmon-Diamond-Taylor, Fermat's Last Theorem (1997) section 3.1 and in Carayol 1986 section 0 for F = Q, but no reading is recorded; Carayol's Theoreme (A) itself is stated through pi_p and the local Langlands correspondence, from which this form is a consequence (with Casselman 1973); locators UNVERIFIED
